author: biql
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own text and teleports (chk-maps run 64). The 56 team spawns stand in a holding room over an unfiltered teleport to `spawn_tele`, so a player lands there; the start is a box round that arrival. Two halves follow: the sea (sea01..sea09, its first platform carries the mapper's START text) and, through a door-sized teleport beside KEEP OUT text, the cave (cave01..cave08). Every other teleport is a section's pit. The cave's last platform carries the mapper's END text (BIQL/ROYALE/TEXT/END, a floor face at [-7112, -2664, 1471]) with no trigger on it; the finish is a box over that floor. Not published.
